Troubleshooting · 23/50 · rights

Unverified font license

Failure signal

A unverified font license condition is reported or detected during rights.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for rights does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Trace every embedded or rendered font to a license covering the intended media.

Corrective action

Replace it with an approved font or obtain written rights before mastering.

Prevention

Add this verification to the rights gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
